en: A monochrome postcard view of a grand historic villa or small castle with a tall pointed tower, sitting on a wooded hillside above a river or lake. A pontoon-style bridge or walkway crosses the water in the foreground, with reflections of the buildings and trees visible in the calm surface. Another large house stands further to the right atop the hill. At the top of the image, in red Gothic-style type, is the printed caption identifying the location.
